# PASS 2 — the walkable surface, and ONLY that. This one ships as
# art/bg-<room>.png, and because it IS the walkable area its silhouette becomes
# the collision mask. Substitute {{ROOM}} and {{FLOOR}}, then run:
#   python3 .github/art/room.py plate games/<id> <room>
#
# Say the exclusion twice. "An empty room" is not how these models read a room,
# and a plate that comes back with a wall or a pool in it silently becomes
# walkable floor.

{{ROOM}} — WALKABLE SURFACE ONLY. This image is the GROUND YOU CAN WALK ON and
nothing else.

Draw, on a background of FLAT PURE WHITE (#FFFFFF) with a crisp hard edge: one
single connected shape of {{FLOOR}}, seen from the same gently-angled top-down
RPG view as the game's rooms, filling most of the frame. Texture it richly —
grain, wear, subtle colour variation — so it reads as a real surface rather
than a flat fill.

CRITICAL: absolutely NOTHING else in the frame. No walls, no water, no pools, no
waterfalls, no fences, no trees, no statues, no fountains, no furniture, no
flowers, no bushes, no people, no sky, no horizon, no background scenery of any
kind, and no shadow cast by anything that isn't drawn. Everything that is not
{{FLOOR}} must be FLAT PURE WHITE. No text.
